app.name: Treasure Hounds
app.long_description:
Four best friends, one pirate map, and one weekend to save their neighborhood.
Sam, Rocco, Gus and Ollie follow Grandpa's map to the lost gold of Ironjaw Jack: through a storm-lashed fishing town, the old smugglers' caves, a booby-trapped temple of bones, and out to Skeleton Cove where his ship still waits. Outsmart traps and the bumbling Crowley gang with nothing but a whip, a lantern and each other.
Hounds stick together!
Controls (Classic Controller): Left stick / D-Pad: walk Y (hold): run B: crack the whip A: talk, read, use, next line L / R: choose who leads (tired Hounds catch their breath at the back) X: map +: pause (music / sound on-off) -: 16:9 / 4:3 screen HOME: exit
